chunks: Allaan narrated via his chain that the Master (peace be upon him) was born in the year two hundred and fifty-six of the Hijra, two years after the passing of Abu al-Hasan.
ai.seo_question: When was Imam al-Mahdi born according to Shia sources?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* anchors the birth of Imam al-Mahdi (aj) in 256 AH, specifically noting it occurred two years after the demise of his father, Imam Ali al-Naqi (as). This precise chronological marker is crucial for Shia scholars in establishing the continuity of the Imamate and validating the lineage of the Twelfth Imam within the historical timeline of the Abbasid era.
